title: Negative steering as an unlearning probe: does suppressing a concept erase or hide it?

original_idea.body: Suppress a target concept via negative steering, then train a fresh probe to test whether the concept is still linearly recoverable; compare weak vs strong suppression.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether steering-unlearning gives false safety assurance, bearing on the unlearning threat model.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Negative steering + fresh probe; clear inherited methodology, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (recoverability under suppression) with defined metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent auditing-flavored work on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Probing-after-intervention exists; this angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steering-suppression recoverability framing may be partly open.
